about: The one Freeweights license table. scripts/licenses.py loads it; build_catalog.py, make_manifest.py, classify.py, policy/license-allowlist.md and site/content/docs/licenses.md all read from it. Keys are license ids, matched without case; `spdx` is the id every catalog row and manifest carries (SPDX case, or a LicenseRef- id). `names` maps a publisher's declared license_name (Hugging Face tag `other`) to a key. Run `python3 scripts/licenses.py --write-docs` after an edit; validate_spec.py fails while the docs are out of date.

permissive.label: Permissive
permissive.meaning: Hosted: listed with a signed manifest. No click-through.

custom.label: Custom terms (hosted)
custom.meaning: Hosted: listed with a signed manifest. The license allows copies with no acceptance gate and no territory limit; its terms show on the entry, and the commands stay folded until you open them after reading the license.

gated.label: Gated (link only)
gated.meaning: From the publisher: the license needs you to accept it at the source. Listed with a link; Freeweights never hosts a copy.

territory.label: Territory-limited (link only)
territory.meaning: From the publisher: the license covers only some countries, and a worldwide hub cannot limit who downloads. Listed with a link; Freeweights never hosts a copy.

non-commercial.label: Non-commercial (link only)
non-commercial.meaning: From the publisher: non-commercial use only. Listed with a link; Freeweights never hosts a copy.

unreviewed.label: License not reviewed (link only)
unreviewed.meaning: From the publisher: no person has read this license yet. Listed with a link; read the license on the publisher's page.

refused.label: Refused
refused.meaning: Not listed. The reason goes to the public refusal log.

copyleft.label: Copyleft license: link only
copyleft.meaning: From the publisher: the license is GPL, LGPL or AGPL. Listed with a link; Freeweights never hosts a copy.

restricted.label: Barred derivative: link only
restricted.meaning: From the publisher: the license of the original allows copies of the original, but not this kind of derivative (a no-derivatives license, or a guardrail-bypass termination clause). Listed with a link; Freeweights never hosts a copy.
